title: Wrike pricing - Free for 5 users, then $10-$25 per user/month, custom above that
clean_text: Wrike's Free plan supports up to 5 users. Paid tiers (annual billing) are Team at $10/user/month and Business at roughly $20-25/user/month, with Business carrying a 5-user minimum that turns the $25 headline rate into an effective $1,500/year floor. Pinnacle and Apex are the top two tiers, sold via custom quote; Apex pricing typically ranges from $60-$80/user/month for teams of 50 or more. Licenses are sold in fixed user bands rather than per exact seat count, and add-ons such as Wrike Lock, Wrike Integrate, and Wrike Two-Way Sync are contact-sales only with no published prices.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, per-seat with fixed user bands
